master.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite animation sheet for a MapleStory-like Korean folk village side-scrolling game.
Image 1 is the EXACT character-design base: 경인년 호걸, upright orange and black striped brawler tiger with broad white muzzle/chest, grey shorts, raised clenched forepaws and curled striped tail. Image 2 is style reference only for clean shaded game sprites.
Redesign image 1 into its unmistakable BOSS evolution, keeping its orange tiger identity and squat upright brawler anatomy. Broader heavy forearms, impressive swept white cheek ruff, thick brows, short red martial headband with two trailing cloth ends, dark iron wrist guards edged in gold, red waist sash over grey Korean martial shorts and a large modest gold tiger-knot belt fitting. Bare white chest; no weapon, no horns, no crown, no Western plate armor. Powerful and fierce but cute readable classic MapleStory monster proportions, slightly left-facing three-quarter view. A visibly authored new boss, not just the ordinary tiger enlarged or recolored, not a white tiger.
Crisp clean dark brown contour about 1-2 pixels at final in-game size; carefully shaded orange/copper fur, white ruff and charcoal stripes. Both pupils are sharply defined matching circular black/amber shapes with the same tiny highlight, naturally embedded in face. No smeared pupils, no pasted-on eyes. Stripes, headband, belt and paws remain anatomically consistent across every pose.
Deliver EXACTLY 24 complete individual frames in a strict 6 columns x 4 rows grid, all transparent cells, NO captions or gridlines. Large even clear transparent gutters between every frame, nothing may touch adjacent cells or image edges. Fixed character body/head scale throughout. Grounding baseline same per cell; no idle artificial zoom.
Row1 six-frame subtle breathing idle: neutral, inhale, inhale crest, exhale, tiny blink, neutral. Body volume stable.
Row2 six-frame advancing brawler walk: planted left step, transition, right step, planted right, transition, left. Actual leg/paw articulation, head remains same size.
Row3 six-frame hit response: receive hit, lean recoil, recoil peak, recover, half recover, neutral. No big scale change and no starburst covering face.
Row4 six-frame death: stagger, kneel, tip to side, lie on side eyes closed, flattened resting pose, final resting pose. Entire character in every cell, no fade/particles.
Each frame must be hand-drawn coherent different pose, not a transformed copy. Entire shorts, feet, tail, sash and headband filled cleanly. True alpha transparency without grey checkerboard, ground shadow, background halo or text.

jump.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent animation sheet of the EXACT orange tiger boss shown in reference: orange black-striped brawler tiger, sweeping white cheek ruff and broad muzzle, bare white chest, red headband with two cloth ends, heavy dark gold-rimmed wrist guards, red waist sash, round gold belt fitting, grey martial shorts and orange clawed feet, curled striped tail. Preserve every stripe/material/face/eye/head size and the shaded crisp classic MapleStory Korean folk village sprite style. Facing LEFT in three-quarter view at all times. Same character scale and body volume in all frames, absolutely no artificial zoom/squash. Matching sharp circular pupils and highlights wherever eyes open; no smeared eyes. Genuine authored pose animation, not rotating/scaling wholebody. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY; no opaque backdrop/gradient/checkerboard/shadow haze. EXACTLY 6 full separate frames in strict 3 columns x 2 rows grid. Each cell has generous transparent gutter on ALL sides, each character occupies no more than 65% of cell width and 65% cell height, even during action. No frame or effect touches another frame/cell or canvas edge. No labels or grid lines. Action: jumping brawler locomotion, 6 frames in reading order. 1 neutral ready stance (full upright reference-sized tiger) 2 deep knee bend and paws drawn in, head size unchanged, 3 airborne tucked legs and bent elbows, 4 airborne legs beginning to stretch downward, 5 landing with knees bent and forepaws balancing, 6 return exactly to ready stance. No dust, no effects, no ground under him. Keep feet at comparable cell baseline: the game itself moves world height, so do NOT position the airborne pose at top of cell. No animation scaling. Shorts/headband/paws fully painted and consistent. Tail articulates naturally.
